page_title: CAD 0-1 BAR | Cadiz CF v Barcelona 13/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Cadiz CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+4' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Cadiz CF have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Wasted opportunity! Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
87' Roger Marti (Cadiz) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Barcelona earn a free kick.
85' Substitution. Joao Felix will be replaced by Marc Casado (Barcelona).
85' Juan Pulido shows a yellow card to Roger Marti (Cadiz) for his blatant foul.
83' Mauricio Pellegrino has decided to substitute Victor Chust and he is replaced by Lucas Pires (Cadiz).
82' Ruben Sobrino plays a pass into the path of Darwin Machis (Cadiz), who shoots way too fast from mid-range and sends the ball miles over the bar.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fermin Lopez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Raphinha (Barcelona).
80' Cadiz CF fail to score from a corner as Marc-Andre ter Stegen (Barcelona) leaps to collect the ball.

79' A big opportunity is wasted by Diadie Samassekou (Cadiz), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the left side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Marc-Andre ter Stegen pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort. The referee points to the corner flag and Cadiz CF will take a corner.
77' Marc-Andre ter Stegen (Barcelona) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
77' It is time for a substitution. Darwin Machis (Cadiz) is on for Robert Navarro.
76' We are about to witness a substitution. Diadie Samassekou (Cadiz) is replacing Alex Fernandez.
76' Here is a change. Juanmi is going off and Mauricio Pellegrino gives the last tactical orders to Roger Marti (Cadiz).
76' Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
74' PENALTY APPEAL by Cadiz CF, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!

72' Joao Felix (Barcelona) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort rattles the left post! What a shot that was! Joao Felix (Barcelona) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
71' Juan Pulido blows his whistle after Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Barcelona have a free kick.

70' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms around the left post.
67' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
66' Flag goes up against Ferran Torres (Barcelona) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
64' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Pulido had an easy-decision to make.
62' Substitution. Jules Kounde (Barcelona) replaces Andreas Christensen.
62' The referee allows time for a substitution. Hector Fort will be replaced by Pedri (Barcelona).
62' Oscar Hernandez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) replacing Vitor Roque.
61' Joao Felix (Barcelona) gets on the end of a cross from Ferran Torres, but his shot goes a whisker wide of the left post.
60' Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
59' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
58' Juan Pulido has a clear sight and sees a foul from Aiham Ousou (Cadiz). There is a free kick near the sideline to Barcelona.
57' Victor Chust (Cadiz) is first to the cross from Ruben Alcaraz, but fires his header just past the left post from close range.
56' Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
56' Cadiz CF take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Cadiz CF get a corner.
56' The ball is cleared after Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Cadiz CF will take a corner kick.
55' Dangerous play by Vitor Roque (Barcelona). Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul. Cadiz CF have a free kick.
54' Juanmi (Cadiz) has a goal ruled out for offside!
53' Joao Felix (Barcelona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
52' Chris Ramos doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
51' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
48' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cadiz CF comes to nothing.
48' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Iza Carcelen (Cadiz). Cadiz CF force their opponents to concede a corner.
47' The attendance is 19607.
46' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Aiham Ousou (Cadiz). Juan Pulido saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Barcelona will take a free kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
45+1' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' What a great touch by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
43' Juan Pulido interrupts the game. One of the players from Barcelona won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Cadiz CF get a free kick.
42' The linesman signals that Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
40' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
39' A quickly taken corner by Cadiz CF.
37' 0 - 1 GOAL! Joao Felix (Barcelona) gets on the scoresheet after finding some space in the box to acrobatically score from the corner kick. 0:1.
36' Barcelona have a corner.
34' Marcos Alonso (Barcelona) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

33' Hector Fort (Barcelona) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Conan Ledesma, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. Good work from Barcelona as they win a corner.

32' Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Cadiz CF win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
31' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cadiz CF.
30' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Corner kick. Cadiz CF will have an opportunity.
29' A pass out of defence finds Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) in space, he doesn't think twice and releases a shot from long range which flies well wide of the left post.
28' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) sends a cross into the box, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen comes off his line to gather the ball.
26' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) was quite harsh and Juan Pulido didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
26' A corner kick by Barcelona is thwarted by the well prepared Conan Ledesma (Cadiz).
26' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Barcelona force a corner. They send men into the box.
24' One of the Barcelona players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. A free kick is awarded to Cadiz CF.
24' The corner by Marcos Alonso (Barcelona) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

24' A cross from Sergi Roberto (Barcelona) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
22' Juanmi (Cadiz) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.

22' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Marc-Andre ter Stegen is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.

20' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
16' Joao Felix (Barcelona) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort well wide of the left post.
13' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) sends a cross in and finds Juanmi inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
10' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
9' Handball by Marcos Alonso (Barcelona). It's a free kick to Cadiz CF, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
8' A player from Cadiz CF commits a rough challenge. Juan Pulido blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Barcelona are awarded a free kick.
6' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
6' Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

5' Juanmi (Cadiz) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. Cadiz CF force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
5' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
3' Vitor Roque (Barcelona) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
1' The match has just started.
Cadiz CF will kick the game off.
